notes: Fixed an issue that could incorrectly mark saved locations as invalid after restarting your Mac or reconnecting a drive.
Fixed an issue where the savings panel could remain at zero after optimization
Improved optimization speed for large folders.
Added Apple Shortcuts actions to list saved folders and start optimization using their configured modes and exclusions on iOS 16 or later.
Added background optimization of saved folders and subfolders on iOS 27 or later, including paths within previously authorized locations.
Added Compress File Copy on iOS 27 or later. Pass a file from another action or a shortcut enabled in the share sheet and receive a separate compressed copy, leaving the original untouched.
Added an Automation section to saved folders, with Add Location Shortcut, folder path copying and setup guidance.
Added help for creating, sharing and running shortcuts, including compatibility and compression limitations.
Updated loading icons and popover dismissal handling.
Improved progress feedback for large selections, with live file counts and clearer status messages.
Added German, Ukrainian, Spanish, Latin American Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
Improved recovery of interrupted compression and deduplication operations when storage identifiers change.
Updated iPad navigation with native tabs and a sidebar.
Improved interface adaptation to changing screen sizes.
Preserved entered text and keyboard focus during navigation layout changes.
Improved share-sheet positioning when rotating or resizing.
Improved regional formatting for numbers, percentages and durations.
Faster optimization of large folders, especially when files are already compressed.
Removed unnecessary repeat folder scans after successful optimization.
Corrected scan counters and misleading time estimates while counting files.
Simplified optimization summaries, with convenient buttons to open Activity, Locations, or Settings.
Activity now explains why files in saved locations were left unchanged.
Improved recovery messages and cancellation of runs waiting for recovery.
Fixed a scan stall in Wine bottles and other folders containing symbolic links.
Updated interface wording and translations.
